strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill survival-crafting，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use for a Minecraft-, Valheim- or Don't Starve-like, or crafting that eats materials or needs that feel like chores.
Workflow: Choose the needs model with the user; Set the clock; Draw the progression ladder; Define recipes as data.
需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：rpg 用 gene_gdsk_rpg_v1，procedural-gen 用 gene_gdsk_procedural_gen_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
